product_brief: Serverless developer platform (built on the workerd runtime) that now exposes ML-KEM and ML-DSA post-quantum primitives through the Web Crypto API.
pqc_support: Yes — opt-in ML-KEM and ML-DSA in Workers Web Crypto behind the webcrypto_modern_algorithms compatibility flag
pqc_capability_description: Workers adds post-quantum Web Crypto algorithms from the WICG Modern Algorithms draft: ML-KEM-768/1024 and ML-DSA-44/65/87, plus encapsulate/decapsulate APIs, getPublicKey(), SubtleCrypto.supports() and JWK import/export. Backed by BoringSSL in workerd. ML-KEM-512 unsupported. Opt-in via compatibility flag; spec still a draft.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM-768, ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87, AES-GCM, HKDF-SHA256, Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA (the latter three mentioned only as comparisons)
primary_platforms: Cloudflare Workers (workerd runtime, built on V8); library-compatible with Node.js, Deno, browsers
pqc_roadmap_details: Not yet implemented and under review: SHA-3, ChaCha20-Poly1305 (XChaCha20-Poly1305 discussed), cSHAKE, TurboSHAKE, and HPKE. All algorithms remain gated behind a compatibility flag; making them default is an open question pending library-author feedback.
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: SubtleCrypto.supports() lets libraries check runtime support for specific algorithms; no scanning or CBOM capability stated.
testing_&_validation_methods: Web Platform Tests for the modern algorithms API surface, Workers-specific compatibility-flag tests, and tests against the panva/hpke and panva/jose test suites.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Open-source workerd runtime; uses BoringSSL primitives; implementation originated from a contribution by Filip Skokan (panva).
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Opt-in via the webcrypto_modern_algorithms flag in wrangler.jsonc. Described as building blocks rather than a full migration path; libraries may need runtime-specific changes. ML-DSA keys and signatures are substantially larger than RSA or Ed25519.

evidence.PQC Support: Today, Cloudflare Workers is adding support for post-quantum-resistant algorithms within Web Crypto.
evidence.PQC Capability Description: ML-KEM-768 and ML-KEM-1024 for key encapsulation ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, and ML-DSA-87 for signatures
evidence.Release Date: Page dates (from the page markup): article:published_time 2026-10-01

evidence.PQC Roadmap Details: For now, all these algorithms are gated behind a compatibility flag.
